text:
mike (sec-eng): FYI tenants in APAC are reporting role reconciliation failures after last night's key rotation. SCIM PATCHes succeed but role.apply shows 500 and some RBAC deltas never land.

lee (infra): thanks. which hosts/region? any pattern in the error?

mike (sec-eng): ap-southeast-1 only so far. log snippet from provisioner on host ap-southeast-1c:

```
2026-03-12T03:07:11Z provisioner[pid=412]: ERROR apply-role tenant=beta-inc user=bob@beta err="KMS:Sign failed: key not found (alias/rdw/provisioner/2026-03-11)" correlation=tx-9a7b
2026-03-12T03:07:11Z provisioner[pid=412]: WARN queued retry for deprov action id=0a9f delay=10s
2026-03-12T03:07:14Z provisioner[pid=412]: INFO scim/patch -> 204
```

mike (sec-eng): Also noticing missing audit events for role.grant at the same time window. securitybot, anything on audit ingestion?

securitybot: Alert: audit.events.role_grant.ingest_drop detected 2026-03-12T03:15:00Z. Dropped count=47 in 5m window. Severity=info.

dana (sre): if the provisioner can't sign payloads it probably retries and holds locks; could explain RBAC flapping and heartbeat gaps. can you run these quick checks on affected nodes?

lee (infra): commands to run:
```
# check agent kms alias and secret
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_alias || echo missing
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_key_id || echo missing
# inspect agent version and bootstrap logs
/opt/rdw/bin/agent --version
sudo journalctl -u rdw-bootstrap -o short-precise --since "2026-03-11 22:00" | tail -n 200
```

mike (sec-eng): ran that on ap-southeast-1c: alias file has alias/rdw/provisioner/2026-03-11 but kms_key_id blank. bootstrap shows a failure to write env var:

```
2026-03-11T23:01:02Z rdw-bootstrap[pid=98]: ERROR secret-inject failed: secret not found in vault path=secret/rdw/ap-southeast-1/provisioner/kms_key_id
```

lee (infra): vault lookup failed during rollout. we scheduled a rotate that replaced aliases and rotated the secret, but vault replication lag hit that shard. kms-bot, confirm secret replication status.

kms-bot: Secret replication status: ap-southeast-1 lagging; last successful sync with primary at 2026-03-11T23:02:10Z. Pending 2/4 replicas.

dana (sre): that matches. agents bootstrapped without key id -> they write alias but can't sign -> retries -> audit events drop. remediation: (A) force-inject kms_key_id into /etc/rdw on affected hosts, (B) restart provisioner service, (C) replay queued deprov actions.

mike (sec-eng): before we push anything, we need to capture evidence for audit and compliance. collect: /var/log/provisioner, /etc/rdw/kms_alias, /etc/rdw/kms_key_id, and the vault bootstrap logs. scrub emails. upload to /shared/sec-incidents/1819990000/.

lee (infra): performing safe remediation now on ap-southeast-1b and -1c. steps: write kms_key_id from backup (vault-primary copy), restart bootstrap agent to re-run secret injection, then restart provisioner.

ops-bot: maintenance: writing secret to ap-southeast-1b done. restarting services.

lee (infra): restarted provisioner on 1b. seeing KMS:Sign success lines again and role.apply completed. pushing same to 1c shortly.

mike (sec-eng): note for postmortem: root causes: 1) secret replication lag to ap-southeast vault shard 2) rollout didn't wait for secret presence 3) bootstrap agent treats missing secret as non-fatal and proceeds to partial config. Proposed mitigations: block alias rotation completion until secret replication confirmation + fail fast bootstrap if critical env missing + alert on agent.kms_key_id empty.

dana (sre): also add metric: provisioner.lock_time and audit.ingest_miss_rate; set an alert when audit drop > 10/min for role events.

lee (infra): opened PR for rollout pre-check and updated playwright for bootstrap to fail when kms_key_id missing. assigning @lee to runbook PR, @mike to coordinate audit backfill, @dana to monitoring changes.

mike (sec-eng): uploaded evidence bundle. kick off backfill with correlation ids from queued actions. will also run a targeted query to find tenants impacted and notify their account teams.

securitybot: Incident recorded INC-20260312-8819 severity=medium status=mitigated

dana (sre): thanks all. reopen if any regression. good triage.
